text:
High School Musical | KayCee Stroh, Monique Coleman
In this episode of the Disney+ Hulu Throwbacks podcast, hosts Sherry Cola and Cierra Ramirez are getting their heads in the game to talk all things High School Musical – the 2006 Disney Channel Original Movie that helped launch the careers of some of Disney’s biggest stars. They’re joined by two of the stars of the High School Musical franchise – Monique Coleman, who played brainiac “Taylor McKessie”, and KayCee Stroh, who played dancing queen “Martha Cox”. Monique and KayCee answer questions, test their memory of High School Musical’s legendary lyrics, hand out superlatives to their castmates, and share the behind-the-scenes stories from their audition days to where their friendship stands today.
